description.value: Maps gender codes used in Mercurius to the GeslachtCodelijst as found in the Dutch [zib ('Zorginformatiebouwsteen', i.e. Health and Care Information Model) Patient v3.2 (2020)](https://zibs.nl/wiki/Patient-v3.2(2020EN)).
